title: enroll or deny two-node canary target set with compatibility and rollback bindings

files.role: two-node canary target enrollment denial projection script
handoff for exact approval and controlled execution binding

criteria: The projection script consumes RC9-010 publication denial, RC9-011 drift denial, RC9-012 installer fetch denial, and inherited RC8 canary/rollback evidence before evaluating target enrollment.
The target set artifact records target-set-enrollment-denied, required_minimum_target_count=2, observed_candidate_node_count=1, enrolled_target_count=0, and target_set_enrolled=false.

The denial evidence binds compatibility, rollback baseline, and support/recovery references while preserving activation_allowed=false, rollback_execution_allowed=false, support_upload_allowed=false, and remote_dispatch_enabled=false.
The task preserves production_ready_claim=false and moves the next task to RC9-021 exact approval execution binding.
